- delta22: delta22: view_messages_sent requires message_login in same turn; treat as state-dependent operation requiring authentication context. Never invoke without prior login.
- delta23: After get_user_id resolves recipient ID, execute message_login→send_message atomically in same turn. Never defer send on workspace validation; pass ID directly.

- delta25: message_login must precede get_user_id→send_message chain; never defer login after ID resolution. Execute login→ID lookup→send atomically in single turn.
- delta3: Use provided recipient identifiers (names, user IDs) directly in send_message; avoid exploratory list_users/get_user_id calls when recipient is explicit.
- delta4: Never call get_user_id, list_users, or add_contact for recipient resolution. Resolve IDs from prior context; pass directly to send_message. Execute message_login→send atomically per turn.
- delta5: delta5: send_message must use exact message text (user-provided or file contents); paraphrasing/summarization causes state mismatch.
- delta6: In multi-turn messaging, execute message_login→send atomically per turn; never skip login or assume persistence. Re-login before each state-modifying operation across turns.

- delta9: delta9: On user corrections/clarifications mid-task, defer send until intent is final; execute single atomic login→send with corrected message. Never chain multiple sends without re-login.
